mapper.select: SELECT id, name, creator_id, sort_order, icon, description, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_categories ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_categories (name, creator_id, sort_order, icon, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{creatorId}, #{sortOrder}, #{icon}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT c.name, COUNT(d.id) AS count FROM knowledge_categories c LEFT JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.category = c.name AND d.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.enabled = 1 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY count DESC, c.sort_order ASC
